Initial release of the Hologram Video Maker Online Free skill.

- Convert images or video clips (up to 500MB) into hologram effect videos with cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM formats; output is 1080p MP4 by default.
- Automates session and token setup, including free anonymous access with 100 credits.
- Provides actions to upload, edit, export, and check credits or project state.
- Includes robust error handling for file size, format, authentication, and rate limits.
- Users interact via natural language; API calls and status updates are handled automatically.
